:[https://web.archive.org/web/20121122060920/https://www.alfa.com.tw/in/front/bin/ptdetail.phtml?Part=AWUS036H Product page]
The FCC test report lists the max output power as 24.66 dBm (292.42mW) :for 802.11b and 19.49 dBm (88.92mW) for 802.11g
EANs for this adapter seem to include 4718050300013 and 4718050300143
===Revision info=== There are (at least) two separate revisions of this adapter.
'''Revision 1''' was branded as a 500mW adapter and includes a 2dBi antenna. :The maximum EIRP with the included antenna is approximately 500mW. *"JJ24UA Ver C 080710" is silkscreened on this board. It may be manufactured by '''[[JJPlus]]'''. :The date code on the below ''Rev1'' unit is '''0843''' (October 2008). :The MAC of this particular unit is prefixed with '''00:C0:CA:1F'''. :<small>'''Additional noted units''' :*[http://foro.seguridadwireless.net/adaptadores-wireless-usb/alfa-awus036h-1w/ Date code '''0741''' (October 2007), '''JJ24UA Ver A 061201''' <!--<small>and '''(=_=) Alex''' <?></small>--> silkscreened on the board, '''Plotech''' PCB manuf.] :*[http://www.wifi-sistem.com/usb-wireless-adaptorler/1414-alfa-awus036h-500-mw-1000-mw-1watt-driver-guncellemesi.html Date code '''0917''' (April 2009), MAC prefix may be '''00:C0:CA:27''']</small>
'''Revision 2''' is branded as a 1W adapter and includes a 5dBi antenna. :The maximum EIRP with the included antenna <!--(assuming the same output power as rev. 1)--> is approximately 1W. *'''[[Accton]]''' would seem to be the manufacturer (presumably w/ an internal model of '''WUS2100-H'''). :"P/N:141000000019W REV:R01" is silkscreened on the board. :The date code on the below ''Rev2'' unit is '''1015''' (April 2010). :The MAC of this particular unit is prefixed with '''00:C0:CA:40'''. :Would appear to be using an [http://www.rfintc.com/ RFIC] [http://www.rfintc.com/pdf_file/AP1046V080812.pdf AP1046 PAM]
An intermediate '''[[Accton]]''' / '''AWB''' manufactured unit (''Rev1.5'', <small>to stick with the 1 for green and 2 for blue</small>) :[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8rXt98n2pcE visible on this '''YouTube''' video] may have also been sold. The model noted on the board's label is '''WUS2100-3895''' (or something like that). :The date code on the board is '''0949''' (December 2009). :The MAC on the unit is prefixed with '''00:C0:CA:3E'''.
===Additional specifications=== The below information is per [http://www.bestpartner.pl/download/20835_st_eng.pdf this datasheet]. It isn't known which revision this was even targeted for.. :and may be somewhat questionable, regardless.. <small>54Mbps and 48Mbps values also seem to have been reversed..</small>
